themes_detail.label: Surge in SPIT Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Special Projects Inspection Team (SPIT) complaints spiked to 7 THIS WEEK, a 409% increase versus the 1.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.62), suggesting either a sudden enforcement surge or emerging code violations in Greenwich Village/SoHo that warrant investigation.
evidence: 7 SPIT complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly baseline (409% spike, z-score: 11.62)
Coincides with high volume of DOB alterations (1,400 filed in last 90 days), suggesting active construction/renovation enforcement
Timeframe: THIS WEEK only — brand new signal
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Buildings to identify which specific properties or blocks triggered SPIT activity this week
Interview residents and business owners in hotspot areas about enforcement actions or code violation notices received

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket complaints exploded to 3 THIS WEEK, a 2,300% increase from the 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 8.69), indicating either rapid deterioration of street sanitation infrastructure or a neighborhood-wide litter problem demanding immediate attention.
evidence: 3 litter basket complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (2,300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Aligns with repeated community board budget requests for 'new or increased number of sanitation trucks and equipment' (ongoing unmet need)
Timeframe: THIS WEEK only — acute spike
reporting_angles: Canvass affected streets (likely commercial corridors) to photograph litter basket conditions and identify pattern
Request Sanitation Department data on basket maintenance schedules and collection frequency in CD 102 this week

themes_detail.label: Animal Abuse Reports Surge
themes_detail.summary: Animal abuse complaints reached 11 three weeks ago, a 780% spike from the 1.2 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 11.76), representing the most sustained and severe animal welfare concern in the district and warranting follow-up on whether the issue has persisted or resolved.
evidence: 11 animal abuse complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 1.2 weekly baseline (780% spike, z-score: 11.76)
Highest z-score of all spikes (11.76), indicating severe statistical anomaly
Timeframe: 3 weeks ago — requires verification whether spike has subsided or continued
reporting_angles: Contact ASPCA and NYPD Animal Cruelty Investigations Unit for incident details from 3 weeks ago; determine if cases were prosecuted
Interview animal welfare advocates or shelter workers about whether reported incidents point to organized animal fighting, hoarding, or broader neglect patterns in specific neighborhoods

themes_detail.label: Infrastructure Degradation: Sidewalks & Curbs
themes_detail.summary: Root/sewer/sidewalk and curb condition complaints surged last week to 4 and 13 respectively—3,100% and 550% increases from baseline—indicating accelerating pavement and drainage infrastructure failure across the district that may foreshadow safety hazards or costly repairs.
evidence: Root/Sewer/Sidewalk: 4 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (3,100% spike, z-score: 11.72)
Curb Condition: 13 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.0 weekly average (550% spike, z-score: 11.0)
Sidewalk Condition: 23 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 7.4 weekly average (212% spike, z-score: 5.91)
Convergence: Community board repeatedly requests 'catch basin cleaning' and 'street tree maintenance'—suggests chronic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Request DEP and DOT data on the specific blocks/intersections with recent failures; map pattern to identify hotspots
Document conditions with photos of buckled sidewalks, exposed roots, and damaged curbs; interview residents about trip hazards or complaints

themes_detail.label: Helicopter Noise Spike
themes_detail.summary: Helicopter noise complaints reached 3 three weeks ago, a 2,300% increase from the 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 8.69), suggesting either a singular major event or emerging aerial activity pattern that may indicate increased police/emergency operations or commercial helicopter traffic over the district.
evidence: 3 helicopter noise complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (2,300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Timeframe: 3 weeks ago—unclear if isolated event or sustained activity; requires follow-up verification
reporting_angles: Cross-reference complaint dates with NYPD activity logs, Coast Guard operations, or hospital/news helicopter traffic around the district
Interview residents to identify whether complaints clustered in one neighborhood or dispersed; ask if activity has continued or ceased
